name: PCM offline bench evaluation

runner.compatibility_model: protocol 1.0 is the frozen, live-validated production baseline; protocol 1.1 is an additive outer orchestration layer and must not change protocol 1.0 executor semantics

scope.request_model: the user declares required products; the planner resolves their dependencies and executes only missing or invalid nodes
scope.package_acquisition: personal AI selects one approved adapter; credentials remain external
scope.evaluation_library_compilation: optional deterministic workstation helper inside an approved LiDocker environment
scope.reuse_policy: reuse only when the recorded content identity and current verification both match

deployment.personal_computer: AI agent plus versioned skill and the submitter's forwarded SSH agent
deployment.shared_workstation: deterministic CLI/runner, shared prediction authority and evidence store; no AI
deployment.bench: evaluated application and prediction producer only
deployment.lpai: per-user prediction copy and evaluation compute space

targets.workstation_predictions: a hash-verified, team-shareable prediction product on the workstation
targets.lpai_predictions: a copy published from the verified workstation product into the submitter's personal LPAI space
targets.evaluation_report: a valid report produced or verified by an identity-matching immutable evaluation attempt

sources.workstation_predictions: allows publish-only or evaluate workflows to begin from an existing verified workstation product
sources.lpai_predictions: allows evaluate-only workflows to begin from an existing verified personal LPAI product
constraints: workstation_predictions and lpai_predictions cannot both be declared as prediction sources
a product cannot be declared as both a supplied source and a requested target

prediction_route.optional_personal_route: workstation shared verified product -> submitter's LPAI development space
prediction_route.rule: LPAI upload or evaluation failure never triggers another bench replay

planning.approval_rule: ACTIVATE and REPLAY approvals are required only when the resolved plan needs the bench
planning.lock_rule: the worker recomputes requires_bench from immutable job.json and the selected Profile; plan.workflow.requires_bench is audit metadata that must match the recomputed value before executor, SSH or lock operations
planning.non_bench_rule: a workflow that starts from a supplied workstation or LPAI prediction product does not claim bench.lock and may run while the bench is occupied
planning.strategy_authority: workflow.bench_strategy is the schema field; formal_update is reserved for an explicitly approved, hash-identified production replacement and all other jobs must match the selected Profile command-set strategy; undocumented top-level execution_strategy is not an override
planning.current_execution_boundary: For this project's new APP path, local acquisition and optional SO build feed the verified /map clean-formal installer; target-workflow orchestrates the reviewed held Stream replay, transfer and optional evaluation path. Historical intake/assemble tools remain for compatibility, not the default skill path
deferred: automatic production orchestration of ACQUIRE, BUILD, INTAKE and ASSEMBLE inside target-workflow
automatic SO selection or takeover of the validated production path for so_policy=auto
general target-workflow requeue or frame-level evaluation resume

receipts.identity: canonical JSON SHA-256 plus file or inventory SHA-256 where available
receipts.reuse: a successful receipt is only a reuse candidate; current inputs and outputs must still verify
receipts.workstation_product_receipt: every supplied workstation prediction product must have an adjacent <product>.bench-eval-product.json receipt whose producer_run_id, current file inventory, inventory SHA-256 and product identity all verify
receipts.legacy_workstation_product: legacy products are never trusted by directory presence or automatic scanning; an explicit backfill may create a receipt only from HOP1_VERIFIED evidence that exactly matches the current product inventory
receipts.evaluation_attempts: evaluation-attempts/<scene>/aNNN is create-only and failed or interrupted attempts are never overwritten
receipts.evaluation_retry: a retry uses the next aNNN directory and a matching -aNNN remote run id
receipts.legacy_evaluation: legacy remote results may be inspected but are not equivalent to a protocol 1.1 identity-verified attempt until migrated

truth_readiness.ready: the scene directory is non-empty and, when required, truth-manifest.json matches its inventory
blocked: the scene directory is absent or empty
the manifest is unreadable or its inventory identity differs
truth_readiness.rule: run.sh must not start unless truth readiness is rechecked immediately before evaluation

coordination.ready_state_semantics: persisted FIFO queue entry after all approvals required by the resolved plan
coordination.personal_session_rule: targets using LPAI run inside the submitter's current agent-forwarding session

invariants: Connectivity diagnostics are read-only and network routes are never auto-repaired
Every user has an individual SSH key even when the Linux account is shared
Only a task whose immutable job and selected Profile recompute to requires_bench=true may claim bench.lock, and the persisted plan must agree
Cancelling a queued run preserves its job, events and approvals
Never extract or stage directly into /app/livc

The current new-APP path prepares a /map candidate, replaces only supplied SO and other specified files, backs up the old formal tree, then installs a clean formal tree with rollback; protocol 1.0 isolated-candidate semantics remain frozen
Any activation requires explicit approval, a validated rollback contract and immutable pre-change evidence
isolated_candidate activation always restores on success or failure
formal_update may retain the new active inputs only after requested outputs, active hashes and service health are verified; any failure before that commit restores once
A bench-producing run cannot release its lock after activation until either restoration or formal activation is verified under the immutable plan
The default held Stream batch does not gate scene progression on prediction files; required workstation products are validated once after batch collection
The final workstation product inventory and the installed formal tree are verified; do not add repeated transfer-time hash gates to the fast path
Every supplied workstation prediction product has a verified producer receipt or an explicit evidence-matching legacy backfill
An existing different target blocks; a residual .partial is preserved and may be copied into a new product only after its full inventory matches the current bench source
A zero evaluator exit code is not success unless candidate frames, completed frames and required task coverage pass validity gates
Passwords, tokens, cookies and private keys are absent from jobs, profiles and reports
Jobs never contain command, argv, shell or script fields; they only select reviewed command sets
Failed evaluation evidence is preserved and each retry creates a new attempt

failure_policy.after_activation: isolated_candidate always restores once; formal_update restores once on any pre-commit failure and retains only after verified commit
failure_policy.restore_failure: mark run unsafe and retain the bench lock for a human owner
failure_policy.publication_or_evaluation_failure: preserve the verified workstation product and resume downstream only
failure_policy.partial_truth: report BLOCKED_PARTIAL and do not delete or replace markers automatically

minimum_final_evidence: requested targets and resolved dependency plan
input content identities and node receipts
scene identity and expected frame count
activation, health-check and either restoration or formal activation evidence when the bench was used
evaluation identity, attempt manifest, command evidence, report and parsed validity
